reasoning: Hantavirus vaccine candidates are in early-stage trials with no Phase 3 studies underway in the US, and the FDA approval process typically requires several years of late-stage data. The 8.5% market probability drastically overestimates the chance of a vaccine receiving full licensure by end of 2026.
evidence_points: No Hantavirus vaccine has entered Phase 3 trials in the United States as of late 2024.
FDA full approval (BLA) timeline for a new vaccine, even with expedited review, cannot be realistically completed before 2027 without active late-stage trials.
Hantavirus diseases are rare, limiting commercial investment and development urgency.
sources_consulted: FDA vaccine approval guidelines and timelines
Existing literature on hantavirus vaccine candidates (e.g., Hantavax, DNA vaccines)
